observed: The image built successfully with the pinned Dockerfile and locked dependencies.
The runtime UID was 10001, and default startup failed without trusted-ingress acknowledgement.
With explicit acknowledgement and loopback port publishing, the container ran with a read-only filesystem, a temporary /tmp, dropped capabilities, and no-new-privileges.
The health endpoint responded and a host-side MCP client initialized, discovered tools, resolved cod and checked public 2022 and 2023 catch weights.
limitations: Local Docker verification is not a GitHub Actions run, security audit, production authorization or model-selected agent evaluation.
The ingress acknowledgement does not authenticate callers.
The container and image were not published or deployed.
